falseSynonyms.zh: 容易不等於基本 easy 表示不難；basic 表示基礎、初級或簡單，基本內容也可以很難。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The concept is basic but not necessarily easy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 便宜不等於基本 cheap 表示價格低；basic 可以指功能少或設計簡單，但不一定便宜。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The model is basic, but it is not especially cheap.

falseSynonyms.zh: 小不等於基本 small 表示尺寸或數量小；basic 表示內容、功能或程度較基礎。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A small device can still have advanced features.

falseSynonyms.zh: 常見不等於基本 common 表示經常出現；basic 表示基礎或最必要的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A common feature is widely used. A basic feature is one of the simplest or most essential.

falseSynonyms.zh: 正常不等於基本 normal 表示符合一般情況；basic 不等於正常。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The normal procedure may include both basic and advanced steps.

falseSynonyms.zh: 原始不等於所有基本 primitive 常帶有原始、落後或早期發展階段的意味，比 basic 更強。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A basic tool may be simple. A primitive tool suggests an early or undeveloped form.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與形容詞不同 basics 是名詞，表示基本知識或基本要素；basic 通常是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We learned the basics. We learned basic grammar.

falseSynonyms.zh: 副詞與形容詞不同 basically 是副詞，表示基本上；basic 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The idea is basically correct. The idea is basic.
